explained.hub.title: How 6529 works, and how we know.
explained.hub.mission: 6529 is a community that collects CC0 art, {perWeek} Meme cards a week; each whole day you hold a card adds to your Total Days Held (TDH), which weighs the votes on the next card.
explained.hub.station.artSay: Every {days} a new card is minted on Ethereum, CC0, about {copies} copies.
explained.hub.station.holdSay: Copies sit in wallets. Up to four wallets count as one identity.
explained.hub.station.timeSay: Meme #2, held a hundred whole days at {rate} a day ({edition} copies). Everyone's, on {date}: {total}.
explained.hub.station.standingSay: Your TDH plus your xTDH sets how much Rep and NIC (Network Identity Check) you can give, and both count toward your Level with the Rep you receive. xTDH is a separate score, never TDH: what other holders grant you, and what the cards you hold produce and you have not granted away.
explained.hub.station.decideSay: Main Stage weighs votes by TDH and picks a card {perWeek} times a week.
explained.hub.station.executeSay: Today 6529's admin keys mint the winner. Network execution is decided, not built.
explained.hub.chapterComing: Explained in {title}, a chapter still coming.
explained.hub.verifyNote.label: At the centre
explained.hub.verifyNote.body: A strong check, not a proof: its history is not yet checked against Ethereum itself.
explained.hub.check.label: Three things checked
explained.hub.check.identitiesBody: identities: 6529.io's TDH equals two separately written recomputations, in each of the {days} results since {first}.
explained.hub.check.identitiesSome: identities: 6529.io's TDH equals two separately written recomputations today, and in {equal} of the {days} results since {first}.
explained.hub.check.theoremsBody: about a model of TDH's rules, checked by machine, and {p53} more about the proposed validator rules. {shownFalse} earlier drafts about TDH were shown false and stay on record. The source is private: only 6529 can rerun them.
explained.hub.check.proofBody: A zero-knowledge proof lets a contract check a program's output without rerunning it. Proof A proved the day of {day} (cycle {cycle}) under the retired {version} rules; mainnet's SP1 verifier accepts it in a read-only call. Proof B is not done; under TDH v1.4 both exist only for a synthetic test cycle.
explained.hub.check.proofWhen: Proof A of {day}, made {date}; proof B not yet
explained.hub.check.candour: Anyone can check each day's file against the index and add up 6529.io's signed upload. Recomputing a day takes your own program and your own read of Ethereum; 6529's are private for now (D116).

explained.hub.cc0.label: CC0, in one minute
explained.hub.cc0.title: The art is free. Holding is what counts.
explained.hub.cc0.body: The Memes are dedicated to the public domain under CC0, Creative Commons' “No Rights Reserved” tool: anyone, owner or not, may copy, remix and sell the art without asking. Owning a card gives no exclusive rights to its image. What holding gives you is TDH, while you hold it.
explained.hub.cc0.keep: For the artist: you make the dedication when your card is released, and it cannot be withdrawn. No one has to credit you, but 6529.io keeps you as the card's artist, and the CC0 deed asks users not to suggest you endorse their work.
explained.hub.cc0.limit: 6529 Gradients are not CC0. And CC0 releases only the artist's own rights: Meme Card #1 shows a CryptoPunk, whose copyright was never the artist's to give, so CC0 does not cover the Punk itself.

explained.hub.guide.body: A shape answers each; a word always says it too. A decision is never shown in green, because decided is not the same as true.
